description.value: Cannery Brewing is a craft brewery founded in 2000, housed in the historic Old Aylmer Fruit and Vegetable Cannery building in Penticton. Their taproom pours a rotating lineup of house-made craft beers alongside a food menu and a seasonal outdoor backyard space. The brewery has ties to the local cycling community, with the Penticton & Area Cycling Association (PACA) credited on their About page.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (14 spaces) at 33m; rack at 54m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is actively open ('TAPROOM IS OPEN 7 DAYS A WEEK', current May–June 2026 events listed), corroborates the OSM address (198 Ellis Street, Penticton) and provides a phone number absent from OSM. No specific mention of bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging is found anywhere in the website content; the About page notably credits the Penticton & Area Cycling Association (PACA) in video credits, suggesting community ties to local cycling. Takeout is confirmed via the explicit 'Kegs to go' offering described on the website.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; 250.493.2723 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating craft brewery and taproom in Penticton with confirmed food service, takeout, and community cycling connections — a natural stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: About page video credits include the Penticton & Area Cycling Association (PACA) and Visit Penticton, indicating an existing relationship with the local cycling community.
